runs.limitation: Fabricated cross-thread pointer/touch messages did not produce the required observations. This does not describe physical touch delivery or a Pigments failure.

correction: The source-owned fixture now sends its generated touch/pointer message sequence on its own UI thread and asserts that the fixture procedure received it independently of the observer. Physical touch remains exclusively operator supplied.
